description: Get details of one app. For Android pass the package name (e.g. com.whatsapp): developer, category, rating and rating count, installs, price, in-app purchases, ads, version, size, required Android version, content rating, release and last-update dates, summary, description and recent changes. For iPhone/iPad pass the numeric App Store id (e.g. 310633997): the same kind of details plus required iOS version, star histogram and languages.

app_id.description: Android package name (e.g. com.whatsapp) or numeric App Store id (e.g. 310633997).

name: get_app
title: Get app details
